use.title: Use file manager
use.description: Browse, edit and transfer files over SFTP.

enable.label: Enable File Manager
enable.description: Browse and edit files on this host over SFTP.

showPanel.label: Show files panel in terminals
showPanel.description: Let the files panel open beside this host's SSH terminal.

transferConcurrency.label: Simultaneous File Transfers
transferConcurrency.description: How many files the side by side local/remote manager uploads or downloads at the same time. Lower this if your server limits SFTP channels.

confirmBeforeTrash.label: Confirm before moving files to trash
confirmBeforeTrash.description: Ask before moving remote files to trash. Permanent deletion still requires confirmation.

companionAutoOpen.label: Open the files panel with new terminals
companionAutoOpen.description: Show the files panel beside every SSH terminal when it opens. You can still open and close it from the button on the right edge.

companionSide.label: Files panel side
companionSide.description: Where the files panel sits next to a terminal.

companionSize.label: Files panel size
companionSize.description: Width in pixels, or height when it is at the bottom. You can also drag its edge.

companionEdgeButton.label: Show the panel button
companionEdgeButton.description: Show a small button on the right edge of a terminal that opens the files panel.

companionFollowTerminal.label: Follow the terminal folder
companionFollowTerminal.description: Move the files panel to the folder your terminal is in. You can switch this off in the panel.

companionSyncInterval.label: Folder check interval
companionSyncInterval.description: How often, in seconds, the files panel checks which folder the terminal is in.

companionHistorySize.label: Folder history size
companionHistorySize.description: How many folders the files panel remembers for each host.

transfer.methodAutoHint: Picks tar or per-file SFTP based on file count, size, and compressibility. Single files always use streaming SFTP.
transfer.methodItemSftpHint: Transfer each file individually over SFTP. Works on all hosts including Windows.
transfer.methodItemSftpLimitation: Each file uses the same SFTP stream as a single-file copy, one after another. Progress is combined across all files, so the bar moves slowly during large files.
transfer.methodPreviewError: Could not preview transfer method. The server will still pick a method when you start.

methodReason.tar_unavailable: Tar is not available on one or both hosts, so per-file SFTP will be used instead.
methodReason.windows_host: A Windows host is involved, so tar is not used.
methodReason.auto_multi_large: Auto: multiple files including a large file ({{largestSize}}) with compressible data. Tar bundles them into one transfer.
methodReason.auto_single_large_in_archive: Auto: one large file ({{largestSize}}) in this set, so per-file SFTP.
methodReason.auto_many_incompressible: Auto: mostly incompressible data, so per-file SFTP.
methodReason.auto_many_files: Auto: many files ({{fileCount}}), tar cuts the per-file overhead.
methodReason.auto_default: Auto: per-file SFTP for this set.

transfer.methodTarHint: Compress on source, transfer one archive, extract on destination. Requires tar on both Unix hosts.
transfer.noHostsConnectedHint: Add another SSH host with File Manager enabled in Host Manager.
transfer.parallelSegmentsHint: Large files are split into 256 MB chunks. Multiple lanes use separate connections (like starting several transfers) for higher total throughput.
transfer.resumedHint: Reconnected to an active transfer started in another window.
transfer.transferCancelledCopyHint: Partial files may remain on the destination.
transfer.transferCancelledMoveHint: Partial files may remain on the destination. Source files were not removed.
transfer.transferFailedRetryHint: Partial data was kept on the destination. Retry will resume when the connection is back.
